objective: Contract-first bridge between IFC semantics, OCCT B-Rep/topology, tessellation, and future AIAS render payloads.
architecture: OCCT shape topology is summarized deterministically.
OCCT shapes are triangulated into renderer-neutral BridgeMesh.
BridgeGeometryPayload carries semantic identity, topology, mesh, native shape, and metadata.
canonical_assumptions: Future canonical integration should prefer a new additive root: src/engines/geometry_bim_bridge/.
Canvas should consume renderer-neutral tessellation rather than direct OCCT objects.
Existing Wave 2 OCCT and native IFC runtime backends remain independent and may be adapted at reconciliation time.
